sources.method: Read for product definition, active requirements, constraints, pricing, and validation gates.
Read for business model, architecture, competition, financial assumptions, and deferred scope.
Read for feature requirements, pricing tiers, margin floor, compliance, and out-of-scope items.

methods: Workspace-only review; no network research performed [evidence: worker brief].
Separated repo evidence from external market assumptions.
Preserved existing CivicState narrative and flagged contradictions as surprise spikes.
Built bottom-up financial scenarios rather than top-down TAM.

thesisCurrent.statement: CivicState may be a useful paid constituent-letter workflow, but is not yet a VC-grade business without demand, delivery, and response proof [assumption: EIR judgment from workspace-only evidence].
thesisCurrent.investability: Watchlist, not near-term investible [evidence: worker dispatch registry note].

customerDefinition.primary: Ordinary US residents with concrete civic issues who want researched letters sent to relevant officials [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md].
customerDefinition.excluded: Legal filings, regulatory submissions, lobbying representation, and claim filing [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md, .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md].

marketSizing.method: Bottom-up scenario envelope; no external TAM because workspace-only mode blocks research [evidence: worker brief].

scenarios.name: manual beta
scenarios.volume: 100 paid campaigns/month [assumption: small founder-led test volume]
scenarios.price: $15 blended price [assumption: midpoint of repo tiers]

scenarios.name: local niche
scenarios.volume: 1,000 paid campaigns/month [assumption: one repeatable issue/geo wedge]
scenarios.price: $15 blended price [assumption: midpoint of repo tiers]

scenarios.name: multi-state wedge
scenarios.volume: 10,000 paid campaigns/month [assumption: strong organic loop and durable deliverability]
scenarios.price: $15 blended price [assumption: midpoint of repo tiers]

revenueModel.deferred: Priority complex review and organization API access remain future scope [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md].

manualBetaReconciliation: 100 campaigns/month x $15 blended price = $1,500 monthly revenue [assumption: beta scenario math].
$2 variable cost/campaign x 100 campaigns = $200 monthly variable cost [assumption: EIR buffer].
$1,167.50 contribution after variable and fixed cost [assumption: $1,500 - $200 - $132.50].

goToMarket.nearTerm: Closed beta on one issue category and one geography before SEO or paid acquisition [assumption: validation-first GTM].
gates: At least 95% federal/state and 60% local coverage [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md].

risksAntiPlan.antiPlan: Do not pitch as an AI lobbying network, legal engine, or scaled advocacy marketplace until demand and delivery data prove it [assumption: EIR anti-plan].
risks: Users may not pay for civic expression [assumption: no paid conversion evidence found].
Government email filters may block or devalue AI-generated letters [assumption: deliverability not proven].
Local official data may remain incomplete [evidence: apps/api/src/lib/officials/cicero.ts].
Sensitive political/PII content creates trust and compliance risk [evidence: schema.prisma and privacy page].

assumptionLedger.assumption: $5 to $25 willingness to pay [evidence: repo pricing tiers].
assumptionLedger.validation: Measure preview-to-payment conversion in closed beta.
Track funnel from submit preview to Stripe checkout.
Run Postmark seed and live-domain deliverability tests.

holes.mitigation: Closed beta instrumentation for conversion, repeat use, and support burden.
holes.residualRisk: Demand may remain too weak for a business.

holes.mitigation: SPF/DKIM/DMARC setup plus Postmark domain warming and seed tests.
holes.residualRisk: Government domains may still suppress messages.

holes.mitigation: Cicero versus BallotReady evaluation on representative ZIP codes.
holes.residualRisk: Local coverage may be too expensive or incomplete.

holes.hole: Project identity mismatch between dispatch and repo.
holes.mitigation: Flagged as surprise spike in BUSINESS.md and gate artifact.
holes.residualRisk: Registry may point to the wrong asset.
